text: 你打开门时一阵穿堂风吹来，门猛地撞上墙壁。你正想溜进去，门扇在铰链上剧烈摇晃；你听见另一个房间里有人在地板上急促奔跑。
你想藏起来却来不及了，两名男人冲进客厅，立刻把注意力放在你身上。
他们冲上前来，其中体格较大的那个试图扑倒你。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 144
text: You open the door but it catches a draft, slamming against the wall as you attempt to slip inside. The door rattles on its hinges and you hear the sound of footsteps pounding across the floor in another room.
Your attempts to conceal yourself prove too slow as a pair of men burst into the living room and lock their attention on you.
They rush forward, and the larger of the two tries to tackle you.
